48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
Add 5 days → total added = 341 days.  
Start: 1092-04-24.  
Add 341 days: 1092 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rules apply though Gregorian started 1582; treat as proleptic Gregorian).  
From 1092-04-24 to 1093-04-24 is 366 days (leap year spans Feb 29 1092).  
341 days from 1092-04-24 → 1093-04-24 minus 25 days = 1093-03-30.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1093-03-30
